patthana21.49:1.1: na āsavañceva na anāsavañca na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavoceva nocaāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.49:2.1: na anāsavañceva na nocaāsavaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavoceva nocaāsavo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. gaṇitakena tīṇi. naāsavañcevanaanāsava
patthana21.49:4.1: na āsavañceva na anāsavañca na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavoceva nocaāsavo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.49:5.1: na āsavañceva na āsavasampayuttadukamattañhi pañhe nalabbhati. āsavavippayuttanasāsavaduka nasanidassanattike āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka sanidassanattikaṃ
